name: RedSail Technologies Pharmacy Software
description: RedSail Technologies provides pharmacy software and technology solutions for community, long-term care, outpatient, grocery, large-chain, HME/DME, specialty, and other pharmacy settings. Its family of brands includes PioneerRx, BestRx, NRx by QS/1, Axys LTC, PrimeCare, PowerLine, TransactRx, Emporos, RxMile, and related pharmacy solutions that support workflow, claims, billing, payments, delivery, patient engagement, and pharmacy operations.
